push.title: L 4-5 vs SydSwny FanClub | You: 8.8 (4th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.8 against SydSwny FanClub. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ 4 key passes, the most you've made for us. You threaded the needle and stitched up a chance.
+ A goal against SydSwny FanClub. That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet.
+ Keep finding PhogsToffees; it's working like a charm.
+ Tackles attempted 4, up from your usual 2. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Won your matchup: 8.8 against their best midfielder's 7.6. Proof you've got another gear.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 1. Bread and butter: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- In our wins you average 3 giveaways; here it was 6. Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 4). A little secret: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.
- 5 goals conceded: -0.1. One habit and it's gone.
- A one-goal loss (4-5): a single moment decided it. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.

Garden drill: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.

buddskees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Quiet feet, loud heart.

Don't be hard on yourself; be honest with yourself. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-5 vs SydSwny FanClub | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 5th best match performance of the season, BellyTb1. An 8.8 against SydSwny FanClub, and you looked like you belonged.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ A goal against SydSwny FanClub, your first since Oct 4. Somebody check the net for scorch marks.
+ Your vision plus PhogsToffees's finishing equals a very happy coach.
+ Your 5th best match performance of the season at 8.8. Do it again.
+ Pass accuracy 74%, up from your usual 64%. That's the stuff I want framed.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Game plan: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. Trust me on that one.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Golden rule: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle. Patience, partner.
- Lowest pass accuracy on the team: 74% (best was buddskees's 83%). I'm not mad, I'm just writing it down.
- 5 goals conceded dinged you 0.1. Fixable by Thursday.
- A one-goal loss (4-5): a single moment decided it. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.

Practice this: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Last thing, BellyTb1. Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

You're the real deal. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-5 vs SydSwny FanClub | You: 8.4
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.4 against SydSwny FanClub. I'd give that a gold star if I could find my sticker book.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at SydSwny FanClub's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 0.6 better than usual. The arrow is pointing straight up.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (22 vs their best 17). You can build a whole match on that.
+ 5 goals conceded was worth +0.1 all by itself.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. Habit to build: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Let's not make that a pattern.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.4 (best was buddskees's 8.8). That's the leak in the boat.
- Most misplaced passes on the team: 7 (best was buddskees's 3). Write this down: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Lowest goal involvements on the team: 2 (best was buddskees's 3). That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.

Drill of the day: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: The best time to plant a tree was yesterday. The second best is next match.

You make coaching fun. - Coach Lasso
